faqs.q: What is the Bosch Rexroth PGH4 size 20 internal gear pump used for?
faqs.a: The Bosch Rexroth PGH4 size 20 is a gap-compensated internal gear pump with a fixed displacement of 20.1 cm³/rev. A pinion drives an internally toothed ring gear, and system pressure presses axial washers and radial segments against the gears so clearances adjust and efficiency stays high.

faqs.q: What sizes and part numbers are listed for the Bosch Rexroth PGH4 size 20 internal gear pump?
faqs.a: The listing is the PGH4-3X/020RE11VU2, material no. R901147100, size 20 with 20.1 cm³/rev. It delivers 28.9 L/min at 1450 rpm and 10 bar, runs from 400 to 3000 rpm and weighs 14 kg, with a 101-2 two-hole flange to ISO 3019-1.

faqs.q: How do I choose the right size or model of the Bosch Rexroth PGH4 size 20 internal gear pump?
faqs.a: Choose clockwise (R) or counter-clockwise (L) rotation, since the pump is not reversible, and confirm shaft, flange, ports and seals against your nameplate code. PGH4-3X/020RE11VU2 is the standard build: keyed 25 mm shaft, SAE ports and FKM seals.

faqs.q: What pressure rating does the Bosch Rexroth PGH4 size 20 internal gear pump have?
faqs.a: Rexroth states 315 bar maximum operating pressure for the size 20, with peaks to 350 bar lasting no more than 10 ms each. The pump has no built-in pressure limiting, so the circuit needs a relief valve; speed is limited to 2000 rpm on HFC fluid.

faqs.q: Which materials is the Bosch Rexroth PGH4 size 20 internal gear pump offered in?
faqs.a: The standard build has FKM seals (V), and a W version has an NBR shaft seal with FKM seals. The listing gives hydrodynamic plain bearings, and HLP mineral oil to DIN 51524 from -10 to +80 °C, filtered to ISO 4406 class 20/18/15.

faqs.q: Which standards and documents apply to the Bosch Rexroth PGH4 size 20 internal gear pump?

faqs.q: What does the Bosch Rexroth PGH4 size 20 internal gear pump connect to?
faqs.a: The pump takes a keyed 25 mm shaft or a 15 tooth 16/32 DP splined shaft, with suction DN25 (SAE 1 in) and pressure DN19 (SAE 3/4 in) flange ports. A through drive lets it carry other PGH, vane or axial piston pumps.

faqs.q: How should the Bosch Rexroth PGH4 size 20 internal gear pump be installed and maintained?
faqs.a: Mount the PGH4 preferably horizontal with the suction port at the bottom, keep suction pressure 0.8 to 2 bar absolute and fit a relief valve in the circuit. Filter to ISO 4406 class 20/18/15 and run on HLP oil within -10 to +80 °C.
